mainText: Football in Greenland: The toughest championship in the world?. BBC Sport travels to Nuuk for the Greenlandic Football Championship. A magician and a maverick - this could be Cherki's moment for Man City. After two goals and a swaggering display against Crystal Palace, Phil McNulty asks if this is Rayan Cherki's time to shine for Manchester City. Haaland and Cherki fire impressive Man City to victory at Palace. Erling Haaland and Rayan Cherki both score twice as Manchester City cruise to a 4-1 win at Crystal Palace in the Premier League.

titleText: Other news you might find interesting
mainText: 97-year-old woman rescued after Nepali floods looked like 'a warrior'. A 97-year-old woman, Guna Maya Bohara, survived the flash floods and was rescued using an excavator. Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there. Some of the most dramatic footage from the deadly flash flooding is hidden from public view in China. Man dies and at least six injured after sign falls at Christian festival. A 41-year-old man died at the Christian event near Steyning in West Sussex, police say. Landlady to 9/11 hijackers reveals their links to alleged Saudi spy. A woman who rented out homes to two al-Qaeda members speaks publicly for the first time - to the BBC.
